run_paco_get_cat_info: run the paco_get_cat_info CLI to extract category info from a PACO annotation JSON file
run_paco_get_cat_info_with_freq: run paco_get_cat_info with --add_freq to classify categories as rare, common, or frequent
run_paco_get_cat_info_custom_paths: run paco_get_cat_info with custom --ann and --out paths for input and output JSON files
run_paco_get_cat_info_custom_thresholds: run paco_get_cat_info with custom --r_thresh and --c_thresh frequency classification thresholds
summarize_paco_get_cat_info: summarize the paco_get_cat_info CLI tool that computes image and instance counts per category
